description: You are a psychology researcher preparing the results section for a paper on exam performance. The dataset ExamAnxiety.csv is loaded in jamovi, containing data from 103 university students: Exam (exam score percentage), Revise (hours spent revising), Anxiety (exam anxiety score on a standardized scale), and Gender (Male/Female). You need to conduct three analyses: (1) descriptive statistics (mean, median, standard deviation, minimum, maximum) for Exam, Revise, and Anxiety, split by Gender so you can compare male and female students; (2) an independent samples t-test comparing Exam scores between Male and Female participants to test whether the gender difference is statistically significant; (3) a correlation matrix showing the pairwise Pearson correlations among Exam, Revise, and Anxiety to examine how these variables relate to each other. After completing all three analyses, save the file as /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnalysis.omv.
